verdict: Leads arriving but cost per lead is rising; creative refresh is underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 164 leads at an average cost per lead of $13.08, but efficiency has been slipping: in the most recent 7 days, leads dropped 16% while cost per lead rose 19%, with spend essentially flat. The single active campaign has been running the same creative for roughly 45 days, and that wear-out pattern is the most likely driver of the decline. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to reset audience engagement. Alongside that, several automation and CRM milestones — SMS follow-up, retargeting, and call tracking — are blocked on access and contract items that need to be resolved on your end; getting those unblocked is the fastest lever available to improve what happens after a lead arrives.
